question.en: For how long did the writer give up smoking?

sentences.en: For how long did the writer give up smoking?
After reading an article entitled 'Cigarette Smoking and Your Health' I lit a cigarette to calm my nerves.
sentences.zh: 读完一篇题为《吸烟与健康》的文章后，我点上一枝烟来镇定一下神经。

sentences.en: I smoked with concentration and pleasure as I was sure that this would be my last cigarette.
sentences.zh: 我全神贯注、津津有味地抽着，因为我确信这将是我的最后一枝烟。

sentences.en: For a whole week I did not smoke at all and during this time my wife suffered terribly.
sentences.zh: 整整一个星期我一支烟也没抽，这期间我妻子可受了大罪。

sentences.en: I had all the usual symptoms of someone giving up smoking: a bad temper and an enormous appetite.
sentences.zh: 我有戒烟者所有的常见症状：脾气暴躁、胃口极大。

sentences.en: My friends kept on offering me cigarettes and cigars.
sentences.zh: 朋友们不停地递给我香烟和雪茄。

sentences.en: They made no effort to hide their amusement whenever I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket.
sentences.zh: 每当我从口袋里掏出一包糖果时，他们都毫不掩饰自己的乐劲。

sentences.en: After seven days of this I went to a party.
sentences.zh: 这样过了七天之后，我去参加一个聚会。

sentences.en: Everybody around me was smoking and I felt extremely uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 我周围的人都在吸烟，我感到极不自在。

sentences.en: When my old friend Brian urged me to accept a cigarette, it was more than I could bear.
sentences.zh: 当我的老朋友布赖恩怂恿我接一枝烟时，我实在无法忍受了。

sentences.en: I took one guiltily, lit it and smoked with satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 我内疚地接了一枝，点上，心满意足地抽了起来。

sentences.en: My wife was delighted that things had returned to normal once more.
sentences.zh: 我妻子很高兴，因为一切又恢复了正常。

sentences.en: Anyway, as Brian pointed out, it is the easiest thing in the world to give up smoking.
sentences.zh: 不管怎么说，正如布赖恩指出的那样，戒烟是世界上最容易的事。

sentences.en: He himself has done it lots of times!
sentences.zh: 他自己就戒过好多次了！
